organisationId.description: The organisation id this seating offer is operated by.

replacesNetexId.description: Netex id for the previous material used for this seating offer. If `null` the material on this dated service journey has never been changed.

operatingDate.description: The date which the departure belongs to. Might differ from departureDateTime.

departureDateTime.description: The time of departure from the first station.

createdAt.description: When this seating offer was initially created

updatedAt.description: The last time this seating offer was updated. If `null` the seating offer has not been updated

inactive.description: Whether this seating offer is closed for sale or not

manualMaterial.description: Whether the material for this seating offer was set manually.

transportType.description: The type of transport this seating offer is for.

materialCompositionNetexId.description: Netex id for corresponding material composition.

sequenceNumber.description: Sequence number of the element in this material composition.

direction.description: Direction of the element in this material composition.

ElementPartResponseV1.description: Information about one element in one material composition.

series.description: Rolling stock series of the corresponding element.

seriesVersion.description: Rolling stock version of the corresponding element.

carriageNumber.description: Carriage number for the element in the train.

carriageIdentifier.description: Carriage identifier for the element in the train.

seatmapKey.description: Seatmap key of the basic element. This can be used as a lookup in the seatmap service.

nsrCode.description: Stop Place id defined by National StopPlace registry.

departureDateTime.description: Time of departure from this stop. Set to time of arrival on last stop.

arrivalDateTime.description: Time of arrival on this stop. Set to time of departure on first stop.

sequenceNr.description: The ordering of the station in the journey.

StopPlaceWithTimesResponseV1.description: Destination stop place for this element in this material composition.
